items.evidence: Log lines 2-34: block set to 4 C with lid open, then 1 uL aspirated from each plasmid_plate well A1-H1 and dispensed into the matching transformation_plate well.
Log 35-39: lid closed, block 4 C for 30 min, then 42 C for 30 s on the thermocycler, then back to 4 C.
Log 42-72: 50 uL SOC dispensed into each of A1-H1 after heat shock. Log 73-75: lid closed, then 37 C for 60 min on the thermocycler.
Every aspirate is preceded by a pick up tip and followed by a drop tip, 8 tips on the P20 and 8 on the P300 (log 3-72). No tip is reused.
The step order, volumes (1/10/50 uL), temperatures and times match the paper's LV defaults. Comments are accurate and the choices are stated (lid at 42 C then 37 C, 4 C return before SOC).

judge.summary: The protocol matches the simulator log and the paper's LV Protocol 1 for all 8 plasmids: 1 uL DNA at 4 C, 30 min at 4 C, 30 s at 42 C, 50 uL SOC, then 1 h at 37 C. One fresh tip is used for each transfer, and the comments are accurate.
